videos.title: A practical guide to responsive web design
videos.why: Shows that pages are responsive before you add any CSS, then why fixed sizes break layouts and when you genuinely need a media query.

videos.title: “Designing Intrinsic Layouts” by Jen Simmons—An Event Apart video
videos.why: A longer talk on what Grid, Flexbox and multi-column layout make possible, and how to design layouts that adapt to their content instead of fixed breakpoints.

podcasts.episode: Episode 176: Intrinsic Web Design with Jen Simmons
podcasts.why: The person who coined intrinsic web design explains the idea to Jeffrey Zeldman, and why it changes how we think about screens.
A tour of modern responsive techniques you may not have used yet, useful vocabulary for prompting an AI tool.

reads.title: Responsive Web Design
reads.why: The 2010 article that named the approach of fluid grids, flexible images and media queries, still worth reading for the reasoning.

reads.title: Learn Responsive Design
reads.why: A free course in short modules on layout, typography, images and interaction across screen sizes; dip into one module a day.

reads.title: Axioms
reads.why: Uses line length as the example of setting a rule once and letting the browser apply it everywhere, the mindset behind good responsive work.
